CustomField.description:
Counted as ESR SKU not including TAN-ESR-DEPLMT-EE SKU.
08-21-23 RAP - Updated the formula to account for Amendments. If the quote is an amendment and the effective quantity has increased to the positive, then set Eligible ESR Count to TRUE 11-08/23 KA - Removed the part in formula of capturing Amendment.
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND(
SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-ESR-DEPLMT-EE', SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-PREM-ESR-1W', Is_ESR_Product__c, SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c <> 0 ), True, False )
/*Backup 4/22/2025 IF( AND( Is_ESR_Product__c, SBQQ__ProductCode__c <> 'TAN-ESR-DEPLMT-EE', SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c <> 0 ), /*OR( TEXT(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Type__c) != 'Amendment', AND( TEXT(SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Type__c) = 'Amendment' SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c != SBQQ__EffectiveQuantity__c,*True, False )
*/
CustomField.label: Eligible ESR Count
